contexts.text: The affections of truth are signified by confession and the voice of them that play (). See AC 3880:4.
Infants on earth have similar ideas, when in their plays.
He was... as one who jested () = derision. To jest = to utter as it were a joke, fable, or trifles.
Boys first learn games...
They would be nothing but games like those of infants... or like plays on the stage.

Once when I was playing the familiar game of dice... the Spirits with me spoke about fortune in games, and said that what is fortunate is represented to them by a bright cloud, and what is unfortunate by a dusky cloud; and that when (the latter) appeared with me I could not possibly win; and from that sign they also foretold the alternations of fortune in that game... SE 4567.

They rose up to play () = the festivity of their interiors thence, and consent. To play = the festivity of the interiors; for play is thence, being an activity of the body which comes forth as the effect of gladness of mind; and all festivity and gladness are from the delights of the loves in which the man is... And all interior festivity has in it consent; for if anything dissents... the festivity perishes. Interior festivity is in man's freedom...
The joys and gladnesses which are in the interiors of man are described in the Word by plays and dances. Illustrated.
To play () = the delight from these things.
Hence there is the sport as of infancy in conjugial love.
As infants are in peace, all things with them are full of sport.
Infants are brought into Knowledges of truth and affections of good by means of representatives; as by games suited to the minds of infants. Example(s).
Man may frequent places of amusement... provided that inwardly he thinks becomingly about God, and acts sincerely and justly with the neighbour.
Before the minds (of consorts who are in conjugial love) heavenly delights are almost like the sports of innocence...
(In the Inmost Heaven) all things as it were laugh, play, and live, before their eyes.
Like an actor, when the play is finished.
The dragon said. Now you shall see our sport. Described.
Eternal happiness supposed to consist in plays and spectacles.

In Heaven there (really) are plays and spectacles... in the highest perfection. Such things are also for joys to them, but not for happiness: this must be in the joys... and is possessed by everyone from the use in his employment. Explained.
Outside the city (on the days of festivity in Heaven) there are plays and spectacles.
After noon, games of boys and girls are seen in the streets, which are regulated by their nurses and masters...
At the outskirts of the city there are various games of boys and youths: games of racing; games with balls; games... called rackets...
In its origin, conjugial love is the sport of wisdom and love...
The schools of wisdom (there). TCR 48.
[155a] This (sixth sense of the female sex) is called in the Heavens the sport of wisdom with its love, and of love with its wisdom.
The celestial nuptials of the sport of love and wisdom in the soul...
From the sports so called of heat with light in plants. Explained.

They were conducted to the... places where they had their literary sports; (those namely) of the Heliconides, Parnassides, Athenaeides, and of the Virgins of the fountain... The sports so called were spiritual exercises and trials of skill.
That joys become tiresome from commonness, is evident from plays and spectacles... which in themselves are sweetnesses, because they are vivifications.
(In this case, conjugial favours) are sportive.
I said, I am neither a stage player, nor a vertumnus...
You have taught in the public school exercise that...
Concerning Spirits of various kinds, and their sports.
That when infants play with objects, they suppose them to be alive.
A place where (there are) sports, dances, and the like. SE 3212, Explained.
The Lord's Providence... in games.
(Sports allowed in Hell.)
To play = that which is of the interior festivity which is of the affection of truth and good.
The suckling shall play upon the hole of the viper. AE 410:9. AE 581:5, Explained.
Leviathan is said to play in the sea () from the delight of knowing...
Boys and girls playing in the streets = the affections of good and truth, and their delights.
As all spiritual gladness is from the affection of truth, to play, dance, and sing, are said in the Word of virgins and girls.
As love truly conjugial is innocence, there are sports between married partners like the sports of infants together; and there are such sports in proportion as they love each other...
Conjugial love begins... to inspire sports for the sake of prolification.
Games at home, played with dice, balls, and cards, (are diversions of charity).
